raw_text: Follow `RULES.md` strictly; repo tooling and explicit user instructions win. Inspect task-relevant files; for unclear requests, inspect `README.md`, manifests, module READMEs. Read every file you modify in full before editing. Do not remove, rename, or downgrade intentional functionality unless the user explicitly asked for it. Do not “fix” dependency or type problems by deleting behavior or weakening checks. Keep diffs tight; avoid unrelated refactors and formatting-only churn. Run repository validation commands required by `RULES.md`; treat formatter, lint, warnings-as-errors, tests, and coverage as design constraints. Do not bypass hooks, checks, or validation steps. Never use `--no-verify`. Never commit unless the user explicitly asks.
